evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Story is self-contained functional requirement; no absent complementary capability is evidenced by the backlog for implementing this search feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires user profiles (create/edit/maintain and authentication) but the backlog contains no story for creating or managing user profiles or storing profile data. Related stories depend on profiles.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Relies on the existence of user profiles and an ability to store/user-identify similarity; no profile creation/management or user identity tracking stories are present.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Feature is algorithmic/search-oriented and the backlog contains other search/discovery items; no complementary capability is evidently missing for implementing content-similarity search.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Depends on metadata/tags ingestion which is covered by upload/tagging and tagging-related admin stories; no absent complementary capability is evident from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This provides the creation capability (upload + tags) needed for downstream stories; backlog contains complementary admin processing stories, so no missing capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Viewing thumbnails is a display feature; segmentation and upload stories exist elsewhere in the backlog to support it, so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Search/metadata and similarity capabilities are present elsewhere; no necessary complementary capability (creation/update) is missing for this information feature.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Similar to other search/similarity stories; perceptual-similarity computation is an algorithmic piece and backlog includes similar items—no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Requires stored user profiles and profile-management/tracking capability which are not present in the backlog (no create/edit/auth stories for user profiles).

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Backlog contains an admin story about article summaries (ZO-060) and other data ingestion items; while news ingestion specifics are not explicit, no clear necessary complementary capability is obviously absent for implementing news-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: This is an identification/lookup feature; the backlog contains multiple recognition/identification items. No explicit complementary creation capability is necessarily missing from the set-level view.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Feature can rely on external product databases or recognition modules; backlog provides other identification features and upload, so no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Logo detection is consistent with other detection tasks in backlog; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Similar to other identification stories; no explicit complementary creation/read/update/delete gap is evidenced for implementing brand detection.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Upload and recommendation pipeline is present (upload story ZO-006 and recommendation/search stories); does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Geospatial search/coverage feature can be implemented with existing ingestion/upload stories; backlog does not show a necessary complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR search is an algorithmic feature; ingestion/upload and search stories exist, so no complementary capability for implementation is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Editing/validation assumes segmentation exists; the backlog contains segmentation/automatic detection stories (e.g., ZO-036) and upload (ZO-006), so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction are supported by admin tools and segmentation stories; no necessary complementary capability is missing from the backlog for this admin task.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering is a standalone pipeline; backlog contains ingestion and analysis tasks supporting this, so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: This detection task can be implemented with analysis capabilities; necessary input (uploaded audio) is covered, so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is an automated pipeline; upload and filtering stories exist in backlog and no required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search/prefiltering is supported by upload and analysis stories; no missing complementary capability is evidenced.

evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering is an automated preprocessing task; required ingestion exists and no complementary capability is evidently missing.

evaluations.rationale: Detection task supported by image processing pipelines; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio processing step that can be implemented given upload/ingestion stories; no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping of audio items is algorithmic and supported by ingestion; backlog covers required inputs so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Detection/analysis task supported by audio ingestion; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires monitoring volunteer activity and volunteer interaction events (classifications, sessions); backlog lacks stories enabling volunteer activities (classification/comment creation) and the necessary instrumentation to collect this data.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Dependent on detecting volunteer state/actions; backlog lacks volunteer action creation and the user-interaction tracking required to decide interruptions.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Requires data about volunteer performance/behavior (classifications, history); backlog lacks stories for volunteer classification submission and profile/history tracking needed to support this admin decision.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Same dependency as interrupt/educate items: requires volunteer activity and state data which the backlog does not include (no volunteer classification/comment creation or profile/history storage).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education requires analysis of volunteer actions/history and mappings to educational content; backlog lacks volunteer activity creation and profile/history management necessary to support this.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Relies on volunteers making Talk comments and having them stored; there are no stories enabling volunteers to post comments or defining Talk infrastructure to capture those comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot actions depend on Talk comments and comment-detection infrastructure; backlog lacks volunteer Talk/comment creation stories and Talk platform stories necessary for Zoonibot triggers.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Requires detection of volunteer behavior/comments and a mechanism for Zoonibot responses; backlog lacks volunteer comment/annotation creation stories and explicit Talk infrastructure to enable these interactions.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting Zoonibot messages requires mapping from volunteer actions/comments; without volunteer annotation/comment creation and Talk platform stories, this cannot be implemented—the complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject grouping can be implemented algorithmically from existing assets; while it may benefit from annotations, the backlog contains automated analysis stories and no explicit complementary capability is strictly required.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Requires persistent volunteer profiles/history to record previous experiences; backlog lacks profile creation/management and explicit volunteer activity capture stories needed to support these recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Admin story for article summarization is self-contained; while ingestion details are not explicit, no necessary complementary capability (e.g., create summaries) is absent given typical admin workflows in backlog.
